description: The LLM-facing contract for the deterministic claude-wiki-pages Bun engine — how ANY agent should call it. Trigger when an agent or user asks "how do I call the engine", "what does the engine return", "how do I verify/heal programmatically", or invokes /claude-wiki-pages:engine-api. This is reference material, not an action — it teaches the tool surface.
